target.statement: ROC AUC of SAM++ on the Credit Card Fraud dataset (mean ± 2 std over 10 bootstrapped train-test splits)

compute.basis: Credit card dataset is ~150 MB; SAM fits 30 linear regressions (with optional RANSAC) per split, 10 splits, all CPU-friendly; no code released so implementation must be written from Algorithm 1/2.

blockers: No code released; must reimplement SAM (Algorithm 1/2) from paper text
RANSAC stochasticity and exact hyperparameters (e.g., RANSAC settings, normalization constant) not fully specified, so exact reproduction of 0.92 ± 0.04 is uncertain
title: Real-Time Anomaly Detection with Synthetic Anomaly Monitoring (SAM)
